headline: Shishir Jaipuria discloses substantial acquisition in Ginni Filaments under SEBI Takeover Regs
sum: Shishir Jaipuria has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE indicating a substantial acquisition of shares in listed textile firm Ginni Filaments Limited. The notification is a mandatory trigger under SEBI Takeover Regulations when shareholding thresholds are crossed.
detail: Shishir Jaipuria submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE on 23 June 2026 regarding a substantial acquisition in Ginni Filaments Limited. Under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, any person acquiring shares that cross prescribed thresholds (5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, etc.) must disclose to the stock exchange. The specific shareholding level, number of shares, and consideration remain to be independently verified from the full disclosure document.
